tracks.title: Sold The Blue Dodge
tracks.subject: selling a dead uncle's pickup and keeping the screwdriver from the door
tracks.caption: American bluegrass-leaning Americana played live. Fiddle carrying the melody with a dry rosiny attack, resonator dobro answering with slides, flatpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass walking, no drum kit at all other than a brushed snare in the last chorus. Recorded as a single-room live band with the instruments bleeding together, warm and entirely acoustic, no compression sheen. Weathered male voice, plain and unhurried, joined by a high close harmony only on the chorus. 112 BPM, G major. Plain-spoken, refusing to grieve out loud. No stadium production, no electric guitars, no programmed drums, no pedal steel pads, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fiddle and dobro]

[Verse 1]
Blue Dodge, ninety-four, bed full of somebody else's rain
Uncle Ray drove it to the mill and back for twenty years and nowhere else
The man from Shawnee paid in cash and counted it twice
I let him count. I would have counted too.

[Chorus]
I sold the blue Dodge
I kept the little screwdriver he left in the door
Sixty cents of steel, and it won't turn a thing I own
That's the part I couldn't put a price on

[Verse 2]
Found a church bulletin folded in the visor, dated two years back
He wasn't a churchgoing man. I didn't know he kept it.
There's a lot of him I learned out of that glovebox
More than he ever said to me across a table

[Chorus]
I sold the blue Dodge
I kept the little screwdriver he left in the door
Sixty cents of steel, and it won't turn a thing I own
That's the only part I couldn't put a price on

[Instrumental Break - fiddle and dobro trading]

[Bridge]
Taillights went on down the gravel, and I waved
Like it could see me. Like he could.

[Outro - dobro, slowing]
Blue Dodge, ninety-four
Gone on up the road

tracks.title: Thirty Years On Wednesday
tracks.subject: the hairdresser who has kept a standing hour for your mother for thirty years
tracks.caption: Retro soul cut live with a band. Hammond organ with the rotary speaker audible, a three-piece horn section playing tight punchy figures, bass guitar played with a dead flatwound tone sitting almost like an upright, drum kit recorded with a narrow room mic so it reads nearly mono, tambourine on the backbeat. Warm, narrow, mono-leaning mix with tape saturation and almost no vocal grid-editing. Rich female voice in a full chest register, delivered as a live take with slight pitch drift kept in, backing vocals in a loose trio. 98 BPM, E flat major. Warm and quietly astonished. No modern pop production, no autotune, no programmed drums, no synth, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - organ swell and horns]

[Verse 1]
Thirty years on Wednesday, ten o'clock, the same chair by the window
Donna knows my mother's head better than I know my own name
She knows which year was the hard one. She was there for it, with a comb.
She has never once asked about it. That's the whole gift.

[Chorus]
Thirty years on Wednesday
A woman who keeps a standing hour for my mother
No contract, no kin, no reason she has to
That's a kind of love nobody ever wrote a word for

[Verse 2]
Mama goes in tired and comes out taller
Doesn't matter what Donna did. Might be nothing. Might be everything.
Last month Donna's knees went bad, so Mama brings the chair now
Thirty years in, and the appointment just turned itself around

[Chorus]
Thirty years on Wednesday
A woman who keeps a standing hour for my mother
No contract, no kin, no reason she has to
That's a kind of love nobody ever found a word for

[Bridge - horns only]
I don't go to church
I drive my mother on Wednesdays
Close enough for me

[Outro - organ, fading]
Ten o'clock
Same chair by the window

tracks.title: Vows On A Napkin
tracks.subject: being asked to officiate a friend's wedding and having an empty document called VOWS
tracks.caption: Hybrid-acoustic folk pop: an organic topline instrument sitting over a programmed low end. A solo fiddle riff in a Celtic modal shape as the main hook, played dry and raw, against a programmed sub kick and tight electronic percussion, muted electric guitar on the offbeats, layered handclaps, a brief fiddle-and-voice-only bridge. The acoustic elements are close and unprocessed while the low end is clean and modern. Male voice with clipped staccato phrasing over the beat, conversational, lightly doubled on hook lines. 116 BPM, D major. Nervous and honoured and a little funny. No drop, no supersaw synth, no autotune, no belted climax, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo fiddle riff]

[Verse 1]
You called me first, before your sister, before your mother
Said "you talk fine, and you've known the both of us the longest"
I said yes before I thought about standing up in front of people
Now there's a folder on my laptop called VOWS and it is empty

[Pre-Chorus]
I typed "love is" and deleted it
I typed your two names and left them there

[Chorus]
I've got vows on a napkin from the diner out on Route 9
Two hundred people and a man who's never done this
I'll get the ring part right, I'll get your names right
The rest is me telling the truth about you two, out loud

[Verse 2]
I know about the bad year. I know who slept on my couch and which month.
I'm not putting that in. But I'll be the only one standing up there who knows.
That's why you asked me. I worked that out in the parking lot.
Took me three weeks to work out a compliment.

[Chorus]
I've got vows on a napkin from the diner out on Route 9
Two hundred people and a man who's never done this
I'll get the ring part right, I'll get your names right
The rest is me telling the truth about you two, out loud, once

[Bridge - fiddle and voice only]
I am going to cry in the first thirty seconds
I've decided to let that happen

[Outro - fiddle and kick]
Napkin's in my jacket, second pocket
Checked it four times

tracks.title: Dashcam
tracks.subject: a two-second near-miss on a dashcam you keep reopening at night
tracks.caption: Melodic R&B-rap with autotune used as a texture rather than a correction. Filtered 808 bass with the top end rolled off, a pitched-up chopped vocal sample as the recurring motif, sparse muted electric piano chords, dry rimshot and sparse claps instead of a busy hat pattern, long empty bars. Hazy and narrow mix, everything slightly blurred, heavy autotune on the hook and lighter on the verses. Male voice, conversational and numb in the verses, fully autotuned and melodic on the hook with wide harmony stacks. 76 BPM, B minor. Numb and circling. No aggressive trap hi-hat rolls, no live drums, no shouting, no triumphant turn.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - filtered 808 and pitched vocal]

[Verse 1]
Camera on the windshield caught the whole thing, two seconds, maybe less
White sedan comes through the red and I'm already past where it would have been
I didn't even brake. Didn't have the time to be scared.
Got scared at eleven at night, three days later, watching it back

[Hook - heavy autotune]
I keep the clip, I don't know why
Forty megabytes of almost
Everybody I love is in that car with me in every version but this one
I watch it, then I close it, then I open it again

[Verse 2]
Told nobody for a week, then told everybody in one night
My brother said "that's wild", then started talking about his car
That's fine. That's normal. I wanted it to be bigger than it was.
It was two seconds. It just took up a whole year of room.

[Hook - heavy autotune]
I keep the clip, I don't know why
Forty megabytes of almost
Everybody I love is in that car with me in every version but this one
I watch it, then I close it, then I leave it closed

[Bridge - beat out, voice alone]
Bought new tires I did not need
That was the only thing I could do with it

[Outro - 808 fades]
Two seconds
Still driving
Still slower at that light

tracks.title: Sleep Study
tracks.subject: a night wired up in a sleep clinic, meeting the part of yourself you have never met
tracks.caption: Psychedelic synth pop. Layered analog synthesizers run through a phaser so the whole bed sweeps slowly, drums printed to tape with audible flutter and pitch drift, fuzz bass holding single long notes, a wobbling detuned organ underneath, backwards cymbal swells between sections. Swimming and phase-shifted throughout, deliberately unstable, wide stereo. Male voice drenched in plate reverb and doubled an octave up, delivered flat and detached, never rising in volume or urgency. 104 BPM, F sharp minor. Detached, curious, slightly unnerved. No acoustic guitar, no live-sounding kit, no rap, no big chorus lift, no clean modern mix.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - phasing synth and tape flutter]

[Verse 1]
Twenty-two wires and a chin strap, in a room shaped like a hotel that gave up
The guy behind the glass says "just sleep normally"
Nobody has ever slept normally while a stranger wrote it down
So I lay there performing sleep, an actor with no lines

[Chorus]
Sleep study, room four
They're going to find out what I do when I'm not deciding anything
I have been awake for every thought I have ever had
Tonight somebody else is holding the pen

[Verse 2]
I must have gone under, because there's a gap
Four hours I don't own, and a printout that says what happened inside them
Doctor shows me a graph with a red band straight across the middle
That's me. That's the part of me I've never met.

[Chorus]
Sleep study, room four
They found out what I do when I'm not deciding anything
I have been awake for every thought I have ever had
Tonight somebody else was holding the pen

[Instrumental Break - phasing synths and backwards cymbals]

[Outro - tape stop]
Took the wires off myself
Hair stayed up all day

tracks.title: Golongan Darah O
tracks.subject: donating blood because there happened to be a banner outside the office
tracks.caption: Indonesian literate adult pop. Upright acoustic bass played with fingers and mixed forward, brushed drum kit with loose snare wires, warm electric piano with gentle tremolo, a single muted trumpet answering the vocal at phrase ends. Recorded in a controlled live room, natural decay, nothing gridded tight. Warm male baritone, understated and slightly dry, conversational phrasing with breath left in, no runs. 94 BPM, E flat major. Dry and unsentimental. No EDM drop, no trap hats, no dangdut rhythm, no autotune, no big key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - upright bass and brushed drums]

[Verse 1]
Aku datang bukan karena mulia
Cuma ada spanduk di depan kantor dan aku sedang tidak sibuk
Perawatnya muda, tangannya dingin
Dia bilang "jangan lihat". Aku lihat.

[Pre-Chorus]
Empat ratus lima puluh mililiter
Angka yang terlalu kecil untuk kalimat sebesar itu

[Chorus]
Entah siapa yang akan memakainya
Mungkin orang yang tidak akan pernah aku sukai
Mungkin orang yang suka menyerobot antrean
Tetap kuberikan. Itu bagian yang aku suka.

[Verse 2]
Mereka beri aku teh manis dan dua potong roti
Aku duduk sepuluh menit seperti anak yang disuruh tenang
Ada bapak di sebelah, kantongnya penuh lebih cepat dari punyaku
Dia menang. Aku tidak bilang apa-apa.

[Chorus]
Entah siapa yang akan memakainya
Mungkin orang yang tidak akan pernah aku sukai
Mungkin orang yang suka menyerobot antrean
Tetap kuberikan. Itu satu-satunya bagian yang aku suka.

[Bridge - electric piano]
Di lenganku ada plester bulat
Besok sudah hilang. Tidak ada yang tahu.

[Outro - muted trumpet, fading]
Golongan darah O
Cuma itu yang mereka perlu tahu tentang aku

tracks.subject: being the youngest person in the parents' seats at a twelve-years-younger brother's sports day

[Intro - piano and live drums]

十二歳差の弟 保護者席に座ってるのは俺
周りはみんな親で 俺が一番若い「保護者」

[Outro - keys, fading]
엘리베이터, 일 층, 처음으로 뛰지 않고 걸어 나왔다

tracks.caption: Korean sample-based posse-cut rap. 새벽 다섯 시 버스, 네 시간, 멀미약 두 알

면회, 두 시간 사십 분

면회, 두 시간 사십 분
우리가 고등학교 때 하루에 쓴 시간보다 짧은데

다음 달에 또 간다, 치킨 세 마리

tracks.caption: Korean pop built on a Jersey club rhythmic bed, aiming at the real source form rather than a pop gloss on it. The triplet five-stroke Jersey kick pattern, chopped and pitched vocal samples as the melodic hook, the characteristic squeaky percussive one-shot, short tight sub bass, one detuned synth chord stab. tracks.caption: Sarawakian folk pop built on sape. tracks.title: Nombor Tujuh Puluh Dua
tracks.subject: sitting with a father in a government hospital queue
tracks.caption: Malay devotional ballad in the veteran-diva register. Felt-muted upright piano with the pedal noise audible, a small bowed string section entering only at the chorus, fretless bass sliding between notes, no drums until a soft timpani swell near the end. Recorded in a large natural room, long real reverb tail on the voice. Mature female alto, powerful but held back, restrained Malay melisma on line ends only, chest voice. 68 BPM, F minor. Quiet pleading without self-pity. No pop beat, no synth pad, no percussion kit, no belting until the final line.

tracks.title: 掛紙
tracks.mood: cold, murmured, waiting for an answer
tracks.subject: sweeping a grave, weighting the paper down and waiting for the wind to make it answer
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien folktronica, cold and murmured. A vocoder pad built from the lead vocal itself, percussion finger-tapped by hand rather than sampled so the timing breathes, upright piano run through glitch and automated filtering, hillside field recordings of wind and birds woven into the bed, one wooden acoustic instrument against the synthesis. Cold and sparse and wide, the voice dry and intimate against processed space. Female voice, murmured and close with almost no projection, doubled an octave up by the vocoder on the chorus. 88 BPM, A minor. Cold, waiting for an answer that will not come. No drum kit, no four-on-the-floor, no pop chorus, no traditional funeral percussion, no key change.

tracks.title: 做一桌無人來食
tracks.mood: bright arrangement against a hollow room
tracks.subject: cooking for four and eating three mouthfuls alone
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien retro swing with a big band, bright arrangement set deliberately against a hollow lyric. Full brass section with trumpets and trombones playing shout-chorus figures, drums swinging on the ride with a snappy snare, double bass walking, hollow-body archtop guitar comping four to the bar, clarinet obbligato. Deliberately bright, festive and forward, recorded like a dance band. Mature female voice with confident big-band phrasing and a slight vibrato, sung with a smile that does not match the words. Taigi with a few English loan phrases interleaved, following current practice. 132 BPM, B flat major. Bright arrangement against an empty room. No synth, no programmed drums, no ballad section, no sobbing delivery, no key change.

tracks.genre: Taigi narrative rap over live band
tracks.subject: riding over with five thousand in a red envelope to repay a friend who never once asked
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien narrative rap backed by a live band, in the recent chill-Taigi street-feel idiom. Real drum kit played loose with a fat kick, electric bass sitting slightly behind, muted electric guitar scratching on the offbeats, electric piano holding sustained chords, one trumpet line at the end. tracks.title: เก้าอี้พลาสติกซ้อนกัน
tracks.genre: luk thung with khaen and phin
tracks.subject: stacking the rented plastic chairs after everyone has left the funeral meal
tracks.caption: Thai luk thung with northeastern instrumentation. Khaen bamboo mouth organ playing sustained reedy chords, phin electric lute carrying the melodic answers with its sharp plucked attack, electric bass walking underneath, drum kit playing a loose shuffle, small hand cymbals. Recorded like a live band in one room with the instruments bleeding into each other, warm and slightly rough. Female lead vocal with traditional luk thung ornamentation and the characteristic throat trill on line ends, sung in an Isan register, strong but tired. 102 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Exhausted and plain, grief that refuses to perform itself. No synth, no programmed drums, no pop production, no EDM mor lam remix treatment, no key change.

tracks.caption: Vietnamese folk fusion with electronic production. tracks.caption: Vietnamese posse-cut pop-rap built for three distinct voices. No trap triplet hats, no heavy autotune, no shouted hook, no key change.

tracks.caption: Cantonese bedroom folktronica. Low male rap voice, close and muttered, deliberately flat with no shouting, last word of each line doubled. 140 BPM, F minor. Flat and watchful. No melodic autotune hook, no bright synth, no sung chorus, no boom bap swing.

tracks.title: 交更
tracks.subject: handing over the keys on the last shift after thirty-one years
tracks.caption: Cantonese chamber pop with a real string quartet. Quartet recorded close in a small room so the bow noise and breath are audible, upright piano with felt dampening, a clarinet taking the counter-melody, brushed drums entering only in the last third, double bass pizzicato. Chamber-close and dry rather than cinematic, instruments in the same small space as the voice. Mature male voice, understated and conversational, almost entirely in a mid register with no belting. 74 BPM, A flat major. Dignified, withholding the advice he wants to give. No synth, no programmed drums, no pop production, no choir, no key change.

tracks.caption: Cantonese comedic mainstream rap in the local party-rap lineage. tracks.title: 染髮劑在浴室
tracks.mood: tender, counting something you don't want to count
tracks.subject: dyeing your mother's hair on a chair in the bathroom
tracks.caption: Mandarin indie-crossover art pop in the Taiwanese indie-producer idiom. Clean electric guitar through heavy tremolo and spring reverb playing slow arpeggios, upright bass soft and round, drum kit played with brushes very quietly, one muted trumpet entering in the second half, a held Rhodes chord under the chorus. Hazy and washed, the guitar bathed in spring reverb while the voice stays dry and close. Close male voice, half-spoken and unpushed, breath and consonants left in, no vibrato. 82 BPM, A major. Tender, counting something you would rather not count. No pop chorus lift, no strings, no synth pad, no key change, no belting.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tremolo guitar alone]

[Verse 1]
媽把椅子搬到浴室 說「反正地板好擦」
她自己買的染髮劑 架上最便宜那盒
手套只有一隻 我用一隻
她說「不用怕弄到我 弄到就算了」

[Pre-Chorus]
她低頭的時候 我才看到她頭頂
白的地方 比她講的多很多

[Chorus]
我慢慢塗 一格一格
她閉著眼 跟我講她同事的女兒結婚了
我沒有回話
我怕她聽出來我在數 數她白了幾公分

[Verse 2]
等三十分鐘 我們就坐在浴室裡
她問我要不要吃水果 我說等一下
她說「等一下就忘記了」 然後她還是去切了
頭上包著塑膠袋 走出去切水果

[Chorus]
我慢慢沖 一格一格
她閉著眼 跟我講她同事的女兒懷孕了
我沒有回話
我怕她聽出來我在數 數還剩幾年

[Outro - guitar and trumpet, fading]
浴室地板 一片一片黑的
我擦了很久

tracks.title: 最後一班的我
tracks.subject: a bus driver's last night shift after nineteen years on the same route
tracks.caption: Mandarin narrative rap backed by a live band rather than a programmed beat. Real drum kit played with a loose brushed shuffle, electric bass with a warm flatwound tone, clean electric guitar comping on the offbeats, Wurlitzer electric piano holding chords, one trumpet line in the bridge. Recorded like a band in a room with natural drum decay and no sample replacement. Mid-range male voice rapping with spoken weight, unhurried storytelling flow, no doubling, no shouting. 92 BPM, D minor. Steady and dignified, refusing to complain. No 808, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no sung pop chorus, no orchestral strings.

tracks.title: 魚缸
tracks.subject: giving away four years of fish on moving day because the tank is not insured
tracks.caption: Mandarin cinematic electronic with a traditional instrument used as the lead voice. Guzheng plucked dry and close with its natural attack and string buzz, a huge low analog synth pad underneath, slow sub-bass pulse instead of drums, processed breath samples as rhythm, one filtered string swell in the final chorus. tracks.caption: Mandarin adult contemporary ballad. Grand piano recorded close with the pedal and hammers audible as the core, a real string quartet entering only from the first chorus and kept wide, fretless bass sliding between notes, brushed drums very soft and late, no cymbal crashes. Classic ballad staging with the piano intimate and forward and the strings wide and distant. Mature female voice, understated and conversational, no runs and no belting, the final line almost whispered. 66 BPM, B flat major. Restraint held as an act of love. No programmed drums, no synth, no modulation, no big climax, no choir.

tracks.title: 拿錯了
tracks.subject: taking the food delivery left outside your door with someone else's name on it
tracks.caption: Mandarin indie band power pop, fast and bright. Two jangly electric guitars doubled wide with light overdrive, drums played fast and hard with an open snare, bass played with a pick riding eighth notes, handclaps on the chorus, one guitar solo of four bars. Bright and punchy mix with the guitars forward and plenty of top end. Young male voice, rushed and slightly shouted, cramming syllables against the beat, gang backing vocals on the hook. 168 BPM, E major. Comic guilt with confessional energy. No ballad section, no synth, no autotune, no trap drums, no key change.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - jangly guitars and fast drums]

[Verse 1]
外送放在門口 名字不是我
我看了三秒 我拿進來了
我發誓我本來只是要看一下那是什麼
結果是我最想吃的那一家

[Pre-Chorus]
樓上有人在找 我聽到腳步聲
我把袋子藏到廚房 像在藏證據

[Chorus]
我拿錯了 我沒有錯拿
這兩句不一樣 我知道
我吃完了 我洗了碗 我洗得超乾淨
好像洗乾淨就沒發生

[Verse 2]
隔天我在電梯遇到七樓那個人
他跟我說「昨天我外送被偷」
我說「真的假的 好扯」
我真的這樣說 我聽到我自己這樣說

[Chorus]
我拿錯了 我沒有錯拿
這兩句不一樣 我知道
我吃完了 我洗了碗 我洗得超乾淨
但我現在還記得那個味道

[Bridge - guitar solo]

[Verse 3]
我點了一份一樣的 放在他門口
沒有寫名字 他可能也拿進去了
那我們就一樣了 我這樣跟自己講
講完我也不太信

[Outro - cut]
電梯到了 我先出去
[Song ends abruptly]
